user.title: ISP Modem LAN (experimental)
user.description: Choose the exact modem family. Status polling is optional and enabled by default; with it off, only the manual restart button is loaded and credentials are required. Claro restart has been verified; the Vivo button remains experimental and has failed to reboot in HA tests. Both login protocols use unencrypted HTTP: use only on a trusted management LAN. No automatic restarts.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address without a URL or path
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the modem status. If it requires a login, enter the username and password.
error.credentials_required: Username and password are required for Vivo and for button-only setup

init.title: Status polling
init.description: Turn off to stop all automatic modem status requests. The manual restart button remains available when credentials are configured. Status sensors are not loaded while polling is off.

error.credentials_required: Configure modem username and password before disabling status polling
